defectsFound.description: entryTimestamp accepts any finite numeric timestamp, including negative (pre-1970) values, while the generic mapper traceMapping.traceTimestamp (src/importers/traceMapping.ts:18) rejects value < 0 and > 8.64e15. Pi writes ISO strings so numeric input is unlikely, but a Pi entry with timestamp -1 would be recorded as a valid 1969 event time by one mapper and as unknown by the other. Boundary inconsistency, no test covers negative numeric Pi timestamps.
